description.narrative: The project will diversify Thailand's energy mix by adding renewable energy capacity, thus helping the country progress toward its clean energy targets. To achieve sustainable long-term economic growth, Thailand is promoting alternative sources of energy such as solar for power generation, and is beginning its transition to a low-carbon economy. Solar energy is a clean and sustainable source of electricity that diversifies the country's energy mix, strengthening energy security and reducing reliance on fossil fuel.
